title: Misfit Agent Evaluation Lab External Benchmark Evidence Receipt
description: Public-safe provenance receipt for importing evidence from an independently run external agent benchmark. Passing this schema validates evidence shape and provenance fields only; it does not establish independent validation, certification, safety, or benchmark performance by itself.

evaluator_identity.description: Identity of the external evaluator, harness, organization, or reproducible evaluation runtime.

target_identity.description: Public-safe identity/version of the evaluated target; do not include private GHOSBC kernel material or credentials.

artifact_or_result_reference.description: Stable artifact URL, result URI, repository commit, or equivalent reproducible evidence reference.

result_summary.description: Benchmark-native aggregate results. Field semantics remain defined by the named external benchmark.

externally_validated.description: Must remain false unless independent evaluation actually occurred and the referenced evidence supports that statement. Schema validity alone never changes this value.

privacy_boundary.default: No protected GHOSBC/Mother Language/Soul Cipher/GHX/glyph/private prompt/credential/reconstruction material is included.

claims_boundary.description: Must state that evidence is not formal certification, regulatory attestation, or a machine-consciousness claim.
